--- Page 1 (Beckerman_52a) --- Dear Jack, Received your letter a few days ago and was glad to hear from you again. Since I wrote you last the outfit has moved to our new permanent area where the corps will spend the rest of its overseas stay at. It is a university and complete with numerous buildings and they are all very nice. The E.M sleep in the main school building about 10 to a class room and it isn't too bad. But it sure is starting to get cold here and it gets pretty chilly a night. But they are going to put belly stones in all the rooms. The water is so cold you shiver when you get under the shower. We got issued our winter clothing. Eisenhower jackets and all and they sure do look sharp. Everybody looks like a General with it on. I have 58 points as of the last count and it looks like a drop to 50 in Dec and that's where I hope to get. I have a new prefix now too. It is after 2 years in this army. Now don't laugh when I tell you I get in as a O and corps, but I did. So this is now for a 2 year tour. With all in one I'll be the 2 in the 2 year tour. --- Page 2 (Beckerman_52b) --- nothing at me and broke there heart. It isn't too hard, so you know coolas work day on and day off and that's what I like. The people here you can see are a really beaten lot and they sure are in for a hard winter. The geisha houses are open now after being closed for a couple 3 weeks. But there is always a crowd line there. A crap game is starting up now so I will end off and loose some of my eyes. So Long Alice
